queries_run: SoFi Technologies market share gaining OR losing 2026
SoFi Technologies new entrant OR competitor threat personal loans fintech 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 自述各業務面對多元競爭者：優質貸款市場高度分散、有銀行／信用合作社／科技型放款人；存款端有更大的銀行與擁有大量客群的科技／零售公司；科技平台端有大型機構可能壓價。
findings.excerpt: Competition to fund prime loans. The prime lending market is highly fragmented and competitive. We face competition from a diverse landscape of consumer lenders, including other banks, credit unions and specialty finance lenders, as well as alternative technology-enabled lenders.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：新進入者與現有業者可能壓低定價，進而影響市占；公司未揭露具體市占數字。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Additionally, when new competitors seek to enter our markets, or when existing market participants seek to increase their market share, these competitors sometimes undercut, or otherwise exert pressure on, the pricing terms prevalent in that market, which could adversely affect our market share and/or our ability to capitalize on market opportunities.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到獨立第三方測量的 SoFi 市占消長數據，也未找到 2026 年特定新進入者報導；Zacks 稱 2026 Q2 SoFi 放款 148 億美元、Upstart 42 億美元(+50% YoY)，僅有搜尋摘要轉述，未取得原文，列為 clue。

clues.claim: Zacks 2026 報導：Upstart 為 SoFi 科技型消費放款直接對手，2026 Q2 Upstart 放款 42 億美元年增 50%；SoFi Q2 放款 148 億美元，其中個人貸款 107 億美元。
clues.source: Zacks: SoFi Technologies loan boom: can record originations keep climbing
